item.title: Van Go’s Lawrence youth artists to unveil new mural at J.Lynn Bridal & Suiting
item.description: Youth artists employed by Van Go will reveal their latest mural commission during a ribbon cutting Friday at J.Lynn Bridal & Suiting. Continue reading ...

item.title: New Lawrence birthing center, nearing completion, aims to offer personalized care
item.description: A new birthing center in Lawrence will combine two midwifery practices under one roof to offer holistic care to locals wanting a natural birth. Continue reading ...

item.title: Projected electricity usage expected to strain Kansas grid unless transmission, generation added
item.description: Projected increases in electricity load growth are as high as 99% by 2035, a data point that pushed regional energy regulators to create a plan to stabilize and expand grid capacity and transmission, a legislative committee learned. Continue reading ...

item.title: Couple donates $1M to construct accessible entrance to KU’s Natural History Museum
item.description: A gift of $1 million from KU alumni Jann and Tom Rudkin will fund a new accessible entrance to Dyche Hall, home of the university's Natural History Museum. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas adopts faculty workload, post-tenure review system for public universities
item.description: The Kansas Board of Regents ordered state public universities to implement faculty workload and tenure review policies aiming to bring underperforming professors to remediation, with termination as a potential consequence. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence asks residents to weigh in on upcoming capital improvement plan
item.description: As city staff members start developing the capital improvement plan for 2027-2031, they're asking residents to submit project requests to help guide the plan’s development. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas judge rebukes AG Kris Kobach in gender marker case, issues symbolic $1 fine
item.description: Kansas AG Kris Kobach will pay a symbolic $1 sanction in a case regarding gender marker changes on driver’s licenses because he “should have known” better than to file a motion in a court that did not have jurisdiction. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Junior Youth, Youth of the Year to be selected at a single ceremony
item.description: Judges will select the 2026 Lawrence Youth of the Year and Junior Youth of the Year in a joint ceremony next week when candidates deliver speeches to family, friends and community members. Continue reading ...

item.title: Artist invites Lawrence community members to leave their mark on ceramics for arts center exhibition
item.description: In the antiseptic age of AI and ChatGPT, Jason Wang has devised a tactile method to remind Lawrencians of their authenticity, messiness and capacity for human connection. Continue reading ...
